schema.text: If riding cost more (fuel, parking, tolls), would you use your motorcycle or scooter less?

ar.#I'd stop using it for most trips: سأتوقف عن استخدامها في معظم الرحلات
ar.#If riding cost more (fuel, parking, tol: لو ارتفعت تكلفة الركوب (الوقود أو المواقف أو الرسوم)، هل ستستخدم دراجتك النارية أو السكوتر أقل؟
ar.#Not for me: I don't pay these costs: لا ينطبق عليّ: لا أدفع هذه التكاليف

de.#I'd stop using it for most trips: Ich würde es für die meisten Wege nicht mehr nutzen
de.#If riding cost more (fuel, parking, tol: Würden Sie Ihr Motorrad oder Ihren Roller weniger nutzen, wenn das Fahren teurer wäre (Kraftstoff, Parken, Maut)?
de.#No, I'd use it the same: Nein, ich würde es genauso nutzen
de.#Not for me: I don't pay these costs: Trifft auf mich nicht zu: Ich zahle diese Kosten nicht

en.#I'd stop using it for most trips: I'd stop using it for most trips
en.#If riding cost more (fuel, parking, tol: If riding cost more (fuel, parking, tolls), would you use your motorcycle or scooter less?
en.#No, I'd use it the same: No, I'd use it the same
en.#Not for me: I don't pay these costs: Not for me: I don't pay these costs

fa.#I'd stop using it for most trips: برای بیشتر سفرها استفاده از آن را متوقف می‌کردم
fa.#If riding cost more (fuel, parking, tol: اگر موتورسواری هزینه بیشتری داشت (سوخت، پارک، عوارض)، کمتر از موتورسیکلت یا اسکوتر خود استفاده می‌کردید؟
fa.#No, I'd use it the same: نه، به همان اندازه استفاده می‌کردم
fa.#Not for me: I don't pay these costs: مربوط به من نیست: این هزینه‌ها را نمی‌پردازم

fr.#I'd stop using it for most trips: Je cesserais de l'utiliser pour la plupart des trajets
fr.#If riding cost more (fuel, parking, tol: Si rouler coûtait plus cher (carburant, stationnement, péages), utiliseriez-vous moins votre moto ou votre scooter ?
fr.#Not for me: I don't pay these costs: Cela ne me concerne pas : je ne paie pas ces frais

hu.#I'd stop using it for most trips: A legtöbb úthoz nem használnám tovább
hu.#If riding cost more (fuel, parking, tol: Ha többe kerülne a motorozás (üzemanyag, parkolás, útdíj), kevesebbet használná a motorkerékpárját vagy robogóját?
hu.#Not for me: I don't pay these costs: Rám nem vonatkozik: ezeket a költségeket nem én fizetem

it.#I'd stop using it for most trips: Smetterei di usarla per la maggior parte degli spostamenti
it.#If riding cost more (fuel, parking, tol: Se andare in moto o in scooter costasse di più (carburante, parcheggio, pedaggi), li useresti meno?
it.#Not for me: I don't pay these costs: Non mi riguarda: non pago questi costi

tr.#If riding cost more (fuel, parking, tol: Sürmek daha pahalı olsaydı (yakıt, park, geçiş ücretleri), motosikletinizi veya scooterınızı daha az kullanır mıydınız?
tr.#Not for me: I don't pay these costs: Bu soru benim için geçerli değil: Bu masrafları ben ödemiyorum
